symptom: `create or replace microflow M.F …` refused by the splice said "create or modify microflow M.F: this change cannot be spliced into the stored flow …", naming a statement the author never wrote; same for nanoflows, and the same text in check's 'exec would refuse this statement'
cause: The visitor folds `or replace` into CreateOrModify (the two splice alike) and kept no record of the spelling, so flowRefusal had only a literal 'create or modify' to print
fix: Record CreateOrReplace beside CreateOrModify for microflows and nanoflows, carry it on flowDecl, and print the verb as written
insight: When one AST flag stands for two spellings, every message keyed on the flag names one of them wrongly; keep the spelling beside the meaning. A user who wrote `create or replace` and read 'create or modify' reasonably concluded that their statement was silently re-interpreted, which is the opposite of what the refusal is for
